notes.text: The midrash explicitly names Mana in an exposition on the danger of failing to fulfil a vow.
The Nesi’ah article records the episode about Mana and ritual impurity at the nasi’s sister’s death. The primary passage frames the episode within the law for priests.
The Nazir account gives the rule about impurity and Mana’s refusal. The priesthood is Heilprin’s inference from that context.
Tanḥum’s article refers to the signature episode, which has Mana sign and Berekhya refuse. The student–teacher remark belongs to that dialogue.
The cross-reference documents a pedagogical relationship in the dialogue without identifying Assi there. Preserve Heilprin’s explicit conjecture.
